metadata.question: Was the mean aerosol optical depth higher over Chengdu than over Suining between 2001 and 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about comparing mean aerosol optical depth (AOD) between Chengdu and Suining from 2001-2023. For AOD data, I should use MODIS aerosol products: - MODIS Terra: 'MODIS/061/MOD04_L2' (daily aerosol product) from 2000-02-24 to present - MODIS Aqua: 'MODIS/061/MYD04_L2' from 2002-07-04 to present Since the time range is 2001-2023, MODIS Terra should cover the entire period. The relevant band for AOD is 'Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean' or 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean_Mean'. Strategy: 1. Define point geometries for Chengdu and Suining 2. Use MODIS Terra aerosol product (MOD04_L2) 3. Filter by date range 2001-2023 4. Calculate mean AOD for each city using mean reducer 5. Compare the values and output answer Data quality checks: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate AOD values are reasonable (should be between 0-3 typically) (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var chengdu = ee.Geometry.Point([104.066, 30.573]); var suining = ee.Geometry.Point([105.573, 30.526]); var startDate = '2001-01-01'; var endDate = '2023-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra Aerosol var aodCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'); // Check collection size var count = aodCol.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { print("No AOD data found in collection"); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean AOD for each city var chengduMean = aodCol.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: chengdu, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'); var suiningMean = aodCol.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: suining, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data var chengduCount = aodCol.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: chengdu, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo(); var suiningCount = aodCol.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: suining, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo(); // Get the mean values var chengduVal = chengduMean.getInfo(); var suiningVal = suiningMean.getInfo(); // 4. Validation & Final Answer print("Chengdu AOD: " + chengduVal?.toFixed(4) + ", Pixels: " + chengduCount); print("Suining AOD: " + suiningVal?.toFixed(4) + ", Pixels: " + suiningCount); // Check for no valid pixels if (chengduCount === 0 || suiningCount === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid values (AOD should typically be 0-3) if (chengduVal === null || suiningVal === null || isNaN(chengduVal) || isNaN(suiningVal) || chengduVal < 0 || chengduVal > 3 || suiningVal < 0 || suiningVal > 3) { print("C3"); return; } // Compare AOD values if (chengduVal > suiningVal) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
